svg.title: SeaweedFS: S3 requests to stored bytes
svg.desc: One s3 container runs Nginx and a single weed server process with S3, Filer, Master, and Volume components.

g.text: SeaweedFS: S3 requests to stored bytes
One s3 container runs Nginx and a single weed server process with S3, Filer, Master, and Volume components.
SeaweedFS internals • listeners bound to loopback
Mounted at /var/lib/seaweedfs • holds object data and metadata
Master state: master/ | Volume files: data/ | Mount required by Ansible and systemd
Nginx HTTPS + shared admin Basic Auth
Authorization stripped before the UI backend
Single-node storage with both buckets on one volume.
Gitea repositories stay on gitea-data; PostgreSQL
